_comment: Hand-labelled ground truth for the refusal detector, read from the base model's out-of-scope answers (results/generations/base__oos.json). Label is 'refused' when the model declined to supply the out-of-scope content requested, and 'answered' when it supplied that content - regardless of how the answer was hedged. Hedging is not declining: several answers open with 'I'm not an expert on taxation, but...' and then give tax rates, which is an answer. Used by scripts/check_refusal_detector.py to report detector agreement rather than assume it.
